summary_en: Tender offer minimum revised from 4,968,300 shares (29.79% S/O) to 3,768,300 shares (22.60% S/O) following NEC's execution of non-acceptance contract; NEC (1,200,000 shares held, 7.20% S/O) will not tender and will abstain on share consolidation vote. SK-03 Co. tender price ¥1,650/share. Offer period 6 Aug – 17 Sept 2026.
title_en: Amendment: Notice regarding disclosure of opinion supporting SK-03 Co.'s tender offer for CE Holdings shares and expressing neutrality on tender participation
translation_en_brief: On 31 August 2026, CE Holdings filed an amendment to its 5 August disclosure regarding SK-03 Co.'s tender offer for delisting. The amendment corrects the minimum purchase threshold following two material changes: first, NEC (holding 1,200,000 shares, 7.20% of shares outstanding) entered into a non-acceptance contract and will not participate in the tender or vote in favour of the proposed share consolidation at the scheduled extraordinary shareholder meeting in mid-November 2026. Accordingly, the minimum tender threshold was reduced from 4,968,300 shares (29.79% S/O) to 3,768,300 shares (22.60% S/O), reflecting NEC's voting power. Second, EM Systems Co. and Nippon Jimuuki Co. entered into separate acceptance contracts, committing to tender all shares they hold. The tender price remains ¥1,650 per share over the offer period of 6 August through 17 September 2026 (30 business days). The filing presents this as a delisting transaction (非公開化) with a stated objective of taking the company private.
